mission: Independent hostile four-way seam-integrity audit of accepted TD-R00 V553 and TD-R01 V554 architecture against cumulative upstream reality, present implementation, immediate V554 demand, and terminal Rawlsing demand.

executive_finding.reason: Current V552J/V553/V554 code contains rematching, many-to-one pressure aggregation, incomplete exact-reference closure, legacy interpolation/aggregate authority, and a legacy V554 seed consumer. Exact producer identities and permission lineage remain available, so these defects can be repaired within the already accepted TD-R00/TD-R01 families and jurisdictions without illicit reconstruction or semantic redesign.

findings: V550 separates semantic classification from downstream-use authority and exposes independent use gates.
V551 preserves producer-owned structural direction/intensity evidence distinct from V553 temporal delta direction.
V552 exposes deterministic structural fact IDs and temporal-key-source IDs plus source artifact/row/hash lineage.
V552J exposes stable join/packet identity, exact V552 fact and temporal-source fields, admission/use state and producer manifest hashes.
Earlier producer-owned semantics may be reused directly by exact DAG reference rather than republished through V553.
Present V553 remains a provisional v0.2 temporal-pressure implementation rather than the frozen TD-R00 physical contract.
Present V553 calls the V552J structural-dimension resolver, permitting semantic-score fallback when exact producer-bound association fields are absent.
Present V553 groups rows by comparable_temporal_key and can aggregate multiple exact V552 structural facts into one wave/key row.
Present V553 computes the arithmetic mean of pressure_score across multiple source V552 facts in a group.
Present V553 can retain one source_v552_structural_fact_id as primary while relegating the full fact set to diagnostic JSON.
Present V553 schemas do not yet expose the complete GOVERNED_STRUCTURAL_REFERENCE_SET or reference_contract_version.
Present V553 still contains legacy interpolation, country-year, score/readiness and compatibility surfaces that cannot be canonical semantic authority under TD-R00.
Accepted V554 requires immutable BOUNDED_STRUCTURAL_AFFORDANCE F1, machine-addressable STRUCTURAL_MEDIATION_APPLICABILITY_CONDITION F2, and exact-reference V554_V555_HANDOFF B1.
Accepted V554 requires exact V552/V552J/V553 and earlier authority refs without descriptive rematching.
Current ddm_v554_seed_contract.py remains a legacy v0.1 score/seed implementation with hard-coded seed categories, synthetic IDs and interpolation-conditioned readiness.
TD-R01 already blocks production implementation pending final V553 physical bindings and governed V554 rule authority.

facts: Semantic classification is explicitly not permission.
allowed_as_temporal_pressure_indicator is a distinct downstream-use gate.
Directionality authority is not inferred from row-level certification or confidence.
Canonical signed direction/intensity evidence is producer-owned.
Structural direction must remain distinct from V553 temporal delta direction.
Source artifact, source row identity/hash and pressure measurement provenance are retained.
Relation axis, target entity and driver facet are retained on structural facts.

STARVATION.finding: Present implementation can starve downstream by collapse/omission, but exact producer facts/joins remain available and accepted V553 already requires their preservation/direct reachability. No terminally necessary meaning lacks a lawful path under TD-R00/TD-R01.

BLOAT_DUPLICATION.finding: Accepted direct-reference architecture avoids republishing upstream semantics. Legacy aggregate/score/interpolation surfaces would be bloat if retained as authority, but TD-R00 already demotes them.

JURISDICTION_ERROR.finding: No hostile case requires moving measured fact, admission/use, temporal semantics, applicability, mediation, cross-pressure topology, actor development or expression away from their accepted stage owners.

CURRENT_SEAM_MISMATCH.finding: Live code does not satisfy TD-R00/TD-R01 today, but exact producer IDs and permission lineage allow repair without semantic-family redesign or illicit reconstruction.

required_hardenings.name: EXACT_PRODUCER_BOUND_V553_INGRESS_ONLY
required_hardenings.requirement: Canonical V553 admission requires an already-governed exact V552/V552J association. Semantic-score fallback is diagnostic/repair only; absent exact association fails closed to upstream repair.

required_hardenings.name: NO_MANY_TO_ONE_EXACT_PRESSURE_COLLAPSE
required_hardenings.requirement: Distinct same-wave exact V552 facts may not become one canonical V553 observation/value merely because comparable structural key fields match. V553 may not manufacture composition with mean().

required_hardenings.name: DIAGNOSTIC_ID_ARRAYS_ARE_NOT_SEMANTIC_PRESERVATION
required_hardenings.requirement: A singular primary fact ID plus diagnostic list does not satisfy losslessness when listed facts are semantically independent.

required_hardenings.name: TYPED_VERSIONED_REFERENCE_SPINE

required_hardenings.name: SEPARATE_DIRECTION_NAMESPACES
